verdict.rationale: Factory exposes a documented API (OpenAPI spec, sessions endpoints) that lets you create and manage Droid sessions programmatically, and CLI/exec modes support headless automation, showing real API-driven parity for core session workflows. However, many UI-specific capabilities (Missions orchestration, readiness-report/readiness-fix slash commands, Design mode, per-team usage dashboards) are documented only as App/CLI slash commands with no evidence they are exposed as API endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for Missions, readiness reports, design mode, and usage analytics; independent confirmation of full UI/API feature parity.
